title: ID0380676-DC/Si-D/DE- [rjcLZ3] Outlet 1 Out of service
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charging point 1: Out of service (no further description)
Charging point 2: Display shows 56% charging completed, when
entering the menu of charging point two, charging is displayed as active?
Root cause: LEM meter time sync was false
Solution: Rebooted the charger
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: 11/27/2025
